column1: # compilers/MANIFEST.tsv -- one row per bebop.bin that was ever promoted into this tree.
# Columns: digest source_commit source_md5 date fixpoint note
#   digest        md5sum of the binary, first 8 hex chars (the identity used everywhere else)
#   source_commit the commit whose bebop.bin IS this binary (`git log -- bebop-lang/bebop.bin`)
#   source_md5    md5-8 of bebop.bp AT that commit -- the source the binary was built from
#   fixpoint      yes | no | unverified. `yes` means a MEASURED compile(bebop.bp) == digest.
#                 `unverified` is the honest value for a historical row nobody re-compiled;
#                 it is never a synonym for `yes`.
# Written by tools/bebopc.sh save/promote; read by tools/hooks/pre-commit (Guard 1b).
